title: Other test fixtures can still abort the process from a Drop during unwinding
outcome: Each test Drop that can panic during unwinding has been judged, and those that can really abort the process no longer do.
acceptance: Every test Drop in the sweep is listed as able to abort or not, with the reason read from its code
Those able to abort are fixed, using phase_sync::set_gate where the lock is a gate, each with a recorded failing run or a stated reason
